div.head: IV Atr 3.2
div.ab: Si tunc hominem inuenire non possit cui dederit, reddat ipsum tolneum et persoluat, et quinque libras regi.
Si tunc hominem invenire non possit cui dederit, reddat ipsum tolneum et persolvat et quinque libras regi.
Wenn er aber den Mann, dem er [ihn] gezahlt hat, nicht finden kann, so gebe er den Zoll und zahle ihn nochmals, und 5 Pfund dem König.
But if he cannot find the man to whom he paid [it], let him give the toll and pay it again, and 5 pounds to the king.
If, however, he cannot produce the man to whom he paid it, he shall pay the actual toll and as much again and 5 pounds to the king.
